mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at Fireman's Park with a temperature of 65 degrees and a first quarter moon. If you are an early bird, look up at 4:10 AM to see the space station travel from the southwest over Mount Horeb toward the northeast over Fitchburg, reaching almost directly overhead.

The City of Verona is accepting applications for an Engineering Technician to manage municipal projects until September 20. Also, please note that new sewer and stormwater utility rates were approved to keep our local systems self-supporting and prevent infrastructure failures.

We have a busy couple of days! Today, you can visit the Dane County Farmer's Market or enjoy live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, the Verona Ice Arena is hosting a free Girls Try Hockey event.
In a noteworthy call from last Friday, officers responded to a vehicle swerving on the road and arrested a 44-year-old woman for her first O W I after she was found unresponsive at the wheel.
The flavor of the day is Raspberry Cheesecake. The store is currently closed but will open at 10 AM, so get ready for a tasty treat.
